definition: something that grows on a plant or tree, can be eaten, and is usually sweet
exampleSentence: I eat fresh fruit every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào tôi cũng ăn trái cây tươi.

definition: a hard round fruit with red, green, or yellow skin
exampleSentence: I eat an apple every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng ăn một quả táo.

definition: a long curved fruit with a yellow skin
exampleSentence: This banana is very sweet.
exampleTranslation: Quả chuối này rất ngọt.

definition: a round fruit with a thick orange skin, divided into parts inside
exampleSentence: Peel the orange and eat it.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bóc vỏ quả cam rồi ăn nhé.

definition: a fruit with a hard yellow skin and sour juice
exampleSentence: Add a slice of lemon to your tea.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cho một lát chanh vào trà của bạn.

definition: a small juicy green fruit with a sour taste
exampleSentence: Squeeze some lime onto the fish.
exampleTranslation: Hãy vắt một ít chanh lên miếng cá.

definition: a round yellow citrus fruit with thick skin, like a large orange
exampleSentence: Grapefruit has a slightly bitter taste.
exampleTranslation: Bưởi chùm có vị hơi đắng.

definition: a small sweet fruit like an orange, with skin that comes off easily
exampleSentence: The tangerine was easy to peel.
exampleTranslation: Quả quýt này rất dễ bóc vỏ.

definition: a small orange with skin that is easy to remove
exampleSentence: Our teacher gave each child a mandarin.
exampleTranslation: Giáo viên của chúng tôi cho mỗi đứa trẻ một quả quýt.

definition: a small round green or purple fruit that grows in bunches
exampleSentence: I bought a bag of red grapes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một túi nho đỏ.

definition: a dried grape
exampleSentence: I put raisins in my oatmeal.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho nho khô vào món yến mạch của mình.

definition: a soft red juicy fruit with small seeds on its surface
exampleSentence: We picked strawberries at the farm.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã hái dâu tây ở nông trại.

definition: a small blue fruit that grows on a bush
exampleSentence: I like blueberry jam on toast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích mứt việt quất phết lên bánh mì nướng.

definition: a soft sweet red berry that grows on a bush
exampleSentence: We made a bowl of fresh raspberries.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã làm một bát mâm xôi tươi.

definition: a small black or purple berry that grows on a bush with thorns
exampleSentence: We found blackberries along the path.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi tìm thấy dâu đen ven đường mòn.

definition: a small red sour fruit
exampleSentence: Cranberry juice is a bit sour.
exampleTranslation: Nước ép nam việt quất hơi chua.

definition: a small soft fruit with small seeds
exampleSentence: Birds love to eat these red berries.
exampleTranslation: Chim rất thích ăn những quả mọng đỏ này.

definition: a small round red or black fruit with a stone inside
exampleSentence: I put a cherry on top of the cake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đặt một quả cherry lên trên chiếc bánh.

definition: a round juicy fruit with soft yellow or red skin and a large seed
exampleSentence: This peach is soft and juicy.
exampleTranslation: Quả đào này mềm và mọng nước.

definition: a fruit like a peach that has a smooth skin
exampleSentence: A nectarine has smooth skin, not fuzzy skin.
exampleTranslation: Quả đào trơn có vỏ nhẵn, không có lông tơ.

definition: a small round juicy fruit that is dark red, purple, or yellow
exampleSentence: I ate a ripe plum for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã ăn một quả mận chín vào bữa trưa.

definition: a small round orange or yellow fruit with a single large seed
exampleSentence: I put an apricot in my bag.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bỏ một quả mơ vào túi.

definition: a sweet juicy fruit that is round at the bottom and thinner at the top
exampleSentence: This pear is hard, not ripe yet.
exampleTranslation: Quả lê này còn cứng, chưa chín.

definition: a soft sweet fruit with many small seeds, often eaten dried
exampleSentence: I like to eat dried figs with cheese.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích ăn sung khô với phô mai.

definition: a sweet sticky brown fruit with a long hard seed inside
exampleSentence: Dates are very sweet and sticky.
exampleTranslation: Chà là rất ngọt và dẻo.

definition: a soft orange-coloured fruit that grows in hot countries
exampleSentence: A ripe persimmon is soft and sweet.
exampleTranslation: Quả hồng chín thì mềm và ngọt.

definition: a round fruit with a thick reddish skin and many small juicy red seeds
exampleSentence: The pomegranate is full of red seeds.
exampleTranslation: Quả lựu đầy hạt đỏ.

definition: a large tropical fruit with a rough skin and sweet yellow flesh
exampleSentence: We had fresh pineapple for dessert.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn dứa tươi để tráng miệng.

definition: a large round fruit with green skin, red flesh, and black seeds
exampleSentence: Watermelon is great on a hot day.
exampleTranslation: Dưa hấu rất tuyệt vào một ngày nóng.

definition: a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh
exampleSentence: I cut the melon into slices.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cắt quả dưa thành từng lát.

definition: a tropical fruit with thin skin and sweet yellow flesh
exampleSentence: This mango is sweet and juicy.
exampleTranslation: Quả xoài này ngọt và mọng nước.

definition: a large yellow-green fruit of a tropical tree
exampleSentence: We had papaya for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn đu đủ vào bữa sáng.

definition: a large brown seed of a tropical tree, with white flesh and milky liquid inside
exampleSentence: You can drink the water inside a coconut.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể uống nước bên trong quả dừa.

definition: a fruit with thick green skin, green flesh, and a large seed
exampleSentence: I put avocado on my toast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phết bơ lên bánh mì nướng.

definition: a small sweet fruit with brown skin that is green inside
exampleSentence: A kiwi fruit has small black seeds inside.
exampleTranslation: Quả kiwi có những hạt đen nhỏ bên trong.

definition: a tropical fruit with pink flesh and many seeds
exampleSentence: Guava is a popular fruit in Vietnam.
exampleTranslation: Ổi là một loại trái cây phổ biến ở Việt Nam.

definition: a small round fruit with a rough pink-brown shell and sweet white flesh
exampleSentence: Lychees are in season in summer.
exampleTranslation: Mùa hè là mùa của vải.

definition: a small fruit with brown skin and many seeds
exampleSentence: I love passion fruit juice.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rất thích nước chanh dây.

definition: a pale green tropical fruit that has the shape of a star when cut
exampleSentence: Starfruit is sour but fresh.
exampleTranslation: Khế có vị chua nhưng rất tươi mát.

definition: fruit that has been dried, often used in cooking
translation: trái cây sấy, trái cây khô, hoa quả sấy
exampleSentence: I add dried fruit to my cereal.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho trái cây sấy vào ngũ cốc của mình.

definition: a dish of different kinds of fruit cut into small pieces
translation: salad trái cây, hoa quả dầm
exampleSentence: We had fruit salad for dessert.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn salad trái cây để tráng miệng.

definition: coming from the hottest parts of the world
exampleSentence: Mango is a tropical fruit.
exampleTranslation: Xoài là một loại trái cây nhiệt đới.

definition: to become ripe
exampleSentence: The mangoes ripen in the summer.
exampleTranslation: Xoài chín vào mùa hè.

definition: badly decayed and no longer good to eat
exampleSentence: Throw away the rotten apple.
exampleTranslation: Hãy vứt quả táo thối đi.

definition: having a taste like sugar
exampleSentence: These strawberries are very sweet.
exampleTranslation: Những quả dâu tây này rất ngọt.

definition: having a sharp taste like a lemon
exampleSentence: This plum is too sour for me.
exampleTranslation: Quả mận này quá chua đối với tôi.

definition: having a strong sharp taste, like black coffee without sugar
exampleSentence: The skin of a grapefruit tastes bitter.
exampleTranslation: Vỏ bưởi chùm có vị đắng.

definition: containing a lot of juice
exampleSentence: The peaches are soft and juicy.
exampleTranslation: Những quả đào mềm và mọng nước.

definition: the liquid from fruit, or a drink made from it
exampleSentence: I would like a glass of orange juice.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn một ly nước cam ép.

definition: the natural outer cover of some fruits and vegetables
exampleSentence: The skin of a banana is yellow.
exampleTranslation: Vỏ chuối có màu vàng.

definition: the thick skin of fruits such as oranges, which you do not eat
exampleSentence: Do not throw the orange peel on the floor.
exampleTranslation: Đừng vứt vỏ cam xuống sàn.

definition: the hard central part of a fruit such as an apple
exampleSentence: Cut out the core of the apple.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt bỏ phần lõi của quả táo.

definition: a small seed from a fruit such as an apple or orange
exampleSentence: Do these oranges have pips in them?
exampleTranslation: Những quả cam này có hạt không?

definition: the large hard part in the centre of fruit such as a peach or cherry
exampleSentence: Be careful, the cherry has a stone.
exampleTranslation: Cẩn thận nhé, quả anh đào có hạt cứng.

definition: a thin flat piece of food cut from a larger piece
exampleSentence: I ate a slice of watermelon.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã ăn một lát dưa hấu.

definition: to get liquid from something by pressing it
exampleSentence: Squeeze the lemon into the water.
exampleTranslation: Hãy vắt quả chanh vào nước.

definition: to take a fruit or flower from a plant or tree
exampleSentence: We picked apples in the orchard.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đã hái táo trong vườn cây ăn quả.

definition: a group of things growing or held together
exampleSentence: I bought a bunch of grapes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chùm nho.

definition: a place where fruit trees are grown
translation: vườn cây ăn quả, vườn cây ăn trái
exampleSentence: There is a cherry orchard near our house.
exampleTranslation: Gần nhà chúng tôi có một vườn anh đào.
